summary: Stockholm is a stunning capital spread across 14 islands where Nordic elegance meets innovative cuisine and pristine natural beauty. The city seamlessly blends historic Old Town charm with cutting-edge design, world-class museums, and breathtaking waterfront vistas.

restaurants.name: Nalen
restaurants.description: Iconic Swedish restaurant in a historic jazz club setting serving traditional Nordic cuisine with a modern twist. Known for its vibrant atmosphere and classic cocktails.

restaurants.name: Frantzén

restaurants.name: Meatballs for the People

restaurants.name: Artisan

restaurants.name: Riche

activities.name: Vasa Museum
activities.description: Marvel at the remarkably well-preserved 17th-century warship and learn about Swedish naval history through interactive exhibits. One of Scandinavia's most visited museums.

activities.name: Stockholm Archipelago Boat Tour
activities.description: Cruise through stunning archipelago waters, visiting islands and enjoying pristine nature just minutes from the city center. A quintessential Stockholm experience.

activities.name: Gamla Stan (Old Town) Walking Tour
activities.description: Explore narrow medieval streets, colorful buildings, and historic sites in Stockholm's charming oldest quarter. Free to wander, optional guided tours available.

activities.name: Skansen Open-Air Museum
activities.description: Experience 150+ years of Swedish history and culture with historic buildings, traditional crafts, and Nordic wildlife in a beautiful park setting.

activities.name: Royal Palace of Stockholm Tour
activities.description: Visit Europe's largest palace still used as a royal residence, featuring ornate rooms, crown jewels, and changing of the guard ceremony.

activities.name: Drottningholm Palace and Gardens
activities.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed royal residence and stunning formal gardens on a scenic island accessible by boat or subway.

activities.name: Stockholm Pub Crawl & Nightlife
activities.description: Experience Stockholm's vibrant nightlife scene with visits to classic pubs, trendy cocktail bars, and clubs in Södermalm and Norrmalm.

activities.name: Kayaking in Stockholm Archipelago
activities.description: Paddle through pristine archipelago waters, exploring hidden coves and small islands while enjoying peaceful nature and scenic views.

activities.name: National Museum of Sweden
activities.description: Discover Nordic art, design, and craft spanning from the medieval period to contemporary works in an impressive waterfront building.

activities.name: Södermalm Neighborhood Exploration
activities.description: Wander bohemian streets filled with vintage shops, street art, cafés, and independent boutiques capturing Stockholm's creative spirit.

activities.name: Stockholm City Hall Rooftop Tour
activities.description: Climb to the iconic tower for panoramic city views and learn about Swedish government in this architectural masterpiece.

activities.name: Djurgården Island Walk & Museums
activities.description: Stroll through Stockholm's largest park featuring museums, historical attractions, and peaceful nature paths with water views.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for sweeping city and archipelago landscapes
50mm prime for street photography and architectural details
70-200mm telephoto for compressed archipelago and island perspectives
24-70mm versatile zoom for general travel and varied compositions
photography.goldenHourNotes: Stockholm's northern latitude provides extended golden hours during summer months, with the sun dipping below the horizon only briefly. Winter offers dramatic blue hour photography but limited daylight. Spring and autumn provide ideal balance with golden light lasting 1-2 hours and comfortable visibility. Water reflections are particularly striking during golden hour on calm water days.

weather.seasonality: Stockholm experiences dramatic seasonal variation with short summer days filled with sunlight and long, dark winters. Late May through August offers the warmest temperatures, extended daylight hours (near 24-hour daylight in June), and perfect conditions for exploring.
weather.summary: Summer (May-September) brings mild temperatures (13-20°C) and nearly continuous daylight, while winter (November-February) is cold (-3-1°C) with snow and limited daylight. Spring and autumn offer moderate temperatures with pleasant conditions for sightseeing.

hotels.name: Lillehammer Hotel

hotels.name: Hotel Skeppsholmen
hotels.description: Contemporary design hotel on a quiet island with water views, modern rooms, and excellent access to museums and cultural attractions.

hotels.name: Berns Hotel
